name: Answer questions about astronomy and planetary science
description: Users asked for factual information and descriptions regarding astronomical concepts, including classification systems for gas giants, physical characteristics of planets and stars, and celestial navigation. Many requests focused on defining specific planet types based on atmospheric chemistry or appearance, while others sought general trivia or explanations of solar system phenomena.
